description: PER-FILE type-error baseline for libs/papercusp/packages/orchestrator (mirrors packages/operator-core/.tsc-baseline.json and apps/operator-vite/.tsc-baseline.json, P-010/WI-4535/EI-847). A file whose current error count exceeds its baseline here is a NEW, ATTRIBUTED regression and gates lint:tsc:orchestrator (the gate NAMES the file).
note: EMPTY ON PURPOSE — this package is at a strict ZERO, production source AND tests. Do not read `files: {}` as 'not set up yet': the gate runs (npm run lint:tsc:orchestrator) and typechecks ~152 sources, so ANY new type error in this package is a red naming the file. There is deliberately no tolerance left to hide in. HISTORY: WI-6826 (2026-08-02) added the first-ever tsconfig + gate here and seeded a baseline of 59 errors across 12 test files, fixing the 2 production-source errors (readonly-array variance at the parseBlueprintLocalRoots call sites in src/invoke.ts) rather than baselining them. WI-6838 then paid off all 59 and ratcheted this to zero. What they were, in case the shapes recur: (1) 9x TS2554 `expect(x).toBe(y, 'message')` — a Jest/Chai-style second MESSAGE argument Vitest's toBe/toEqual silently discard. The assertions still asserted; what was lost was the custom diagnostic explaining WHY a byte-stability test failed. Fixed by moving the message to Vitest's supported position, `expect(x, 'message').toBe(y)` — verified against a live failing run that the message now prefixes the AssertionError. (2) 1x TS2739 + 2x TS2322 — fixtures omitting or passing `undefined` for BuildPromptInput's required-but-emptiable promptOverride/cwdOverride/featureId; fixed by passing production's real ''/null rather than weakening the type to optional. (3) 5x TS18048 — `spine.edges` became optional and assertions were never narrowed; fixed with `?? assert.fail(<why it must exist>)` so the narrowing is itself the assertion. (4) 38x mock-shape drift — `OrchestratorPg` is generic (`<T = any[]>(…) => Promise<T>`, mirroring postgres-js's `sql<T>``), which a concrete non-generic mock can never satisfy; fixed by declaring each makeMockPg's `pg` as the seam type and casting once at its single return, matching the convention already used at 14 other sites in this package.
